title: Render Network: Miami After Dark
deadline_note: Confirmed Nov 15 2026 on EntryThingy and ArtDeadline; Typeform live
event_location: The National Hotel, Miami Beach, FL – 50-foot large-scale projection
what_they_looking_for: Original digital art up to 2 minutes long, theme 'Miami After Dark'. Must be rendered on Render Network (credits provided to selected artists).
fee_reason: Completely free; rendering costs covered by network credits
receipts_required: Name, email, artist name, portfolio website or Google Drive link of previous work, description of proposed piece. The finished work must be rendered on their network.
search_terms: Render Network Miami After Dark open call
notes: Web3 decentralized GPU network. Strong exposure during Miami Art Week. Open to U.S. artists. Includes exhibition.

title: One Love Art DAO – FRONTERA Open Call
event_location: One Love gallery at Hotel Yve, Downtown Miami
what_they_looking_for: Works that challenge understanding and shift perspectives (FRONTERA theme). Digital or physical; minted or unminted, any chain.
fee_reason: Free open call – confirmed by organizers
receipts_required: Contact info, short statement on how the work fits FRONTERA, portfolio/marketplace links, artwork file (image or short video).
search_terms: One Love Art DAO FRONTERA Miami Art Week
notes: Nonprofit 501(c)(3) Web3 collective. Permanent digital gallery at Hotel Yve. Global artists welcome. Includes exhibition and possible additional partner opportunities.
